       albuild help <command>        Show a command's own options (never runs it).

Commands:
  doctor                 Check host readiness (PowerShell + module + Docker).
  whoami                 Show whether you are local or REMOTE to the container host, and which argument form to use.

  update                 Update the PowerShell module + MCP server in one go (the CLI updates via 'dotnet tool update').
  module install         Install the businessdev.ALbuild PowerShell module (PSGallery).
  module update          Update the businessdev.ALbuild PowerShell module.
  module status          Show the installed/used businessdev.ALbuild module.
  init                   Create an albuild.json in the workspace.
  feeds add              Add a package feed to albuild.json: feeds add <url> [--name --kind apps|symbols|runtime --id-scheme --api-key-env VAR].
  feeds list             List the feeds in albuild.json (read-only).
  feeds remove           Remove a feed from albuild.json by url or --name.  [destructive]
  agents list            List configured MCP agents and their tools.
  agents add             Add/replace an MCP agent: agents add <name> --tools a,b,c (or *).
  agents remove          Remove an MCP agent.  [destructive]
  agents token           Generate a bearer token for an agent (for the MCP HTTP host).
  artifact find          Resolve a BC artifact URL.
  container list         List BC containers (read-only).
  container inspect      Show a container + its installed apps.
  container new          Provision or warm-reuse a BC container (idempotent).
  container restart      Restart a container.
  container remove       Remove a container (destructive; shared -> approval).  [destructive]
  deps plan              Dry-run dependency resolution for a project (read-only).
